name: Updated [NEURO] Jewl Demo Generator - Uses the new template

parameters.query:
SELECT lead_id, email, company_name, city, current_url, outreach_email_used
FROM leads
WHERE lead_id = '{{ $json.body.lead_id }}'
LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "searchStringsArray": ["{{ $('Fetch Outreach Lead').item.json.company_name }} {{ $('Fetch Outreach Lead').item.json.city }}"],
  "maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch": 1,
  "scrapeReviews": true,
  "maxReviews": 5,
  "scrapeImages": false
}

parameters.query:
UPDATE leads SET
  status = 'demo_generated'::lead_status,
  demo_url = '{{ $('Get Vercel Production URL').first().json.production_url }}',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE lead_id = '{{ $('Fetch Outreach Lead').first().json.lead_id }}';
UPDATE leads SET status = 'outreach' WHERE lead_id = '{{ $('Fetch Outreach Lead').item.json.lead_id }}';

UPDATE leads SET
  status = 'demo_sent'::lead_status,
  demo_sent_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE lead_id = '{{ $('Fetch Outreach Lead').first().json.lead_id }}';
